_comment: navya-2 run config — ~4.0B params (dim 3072 x 38, GQA 24/8, head_dim 128, SwiGLU 8192, tied 64k). Requires zero1 (optimizer-state sharding) AND act_ckpt on 80GB GPUs; without act_ckpt use batch_size 8 / grad_accum 128. 9,500 steps x 4.194M = 39.8B tokens (~10 tok/param; phase 1, resume-safe for continuation). LR 3e-4, warmup 1000. lr_schedule wsd, decay_steps 0 = constant trunk; evaluable model from a DECAY BRANCH via make_branch_config.py. Data: data/navya2_v1. grad_accum 32 divides 1/2/4/8.
